name: whatsapp-assistant
description: Local WhatsApp tools: scoped reading, separately confirmed replies, and constrained scheduled sends.

interface.shortDescription: Local WhatsApp tools with confirmed replies.
interface.longDescription: Read selected existing chats through a local OpenWA daemon. Interactive replies require separate confirmation; scheduled sends require a secret, narrowly scoped prior authorization.
defaultPrompt: Summarize recent messages in the selected chat.
Draft a reply and wait for my confirmation.
